subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI messages can reach shared context but still not appear in Open WebUI visible chat history

question: Should OpenClaw core own mirroring external Control UI turns into Open WebUI's visible-history store, and if so what supported boundary should it use?
rationale: The observable bug is real from source inspection, but the likely fix crosses third-party Open WebUI persistence, config/env surface, and upgrade-proof responsibilities that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Approve a bounded opt-in sync path
options.body: Define a narrow Open WebUI mirror/repair contract with explicit configuration, schema/version checks, retry/idempotency behavior, and live Docker proof before implementation.

options.title: Defer until a supported API seam exists
options.body: Keep this issue open as a product/API gap and avoid raw Open WebUI DB writes until maintainers identify a supported Open WebUI API or plugin boundary.

options.title: Declare visible-history mirroring unsupported
options.body: Document that OpenClaw transcript/context is shared but Open WebUI's native visible history is not updated by external Control UI writes, then close the integration expectation separately.

recommendation.title: Approve a bounded opt-in sync path
recommendation.body: Define a narrow Open WebUI mirror/repair contract with explicit configuration, schema/version checks, retry/idempotency behavior, and live Docker proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest combined history across gateway server methods, Open WebUI Docker smoke coverage, and recent Control UI/gateway maintenance.
